title: Create complexity scoring service
description: Create src/main/services/complexity-scorer.service.ts. Score tasks 0-14 across 5 dimensions: files affected (0-3), estimated lines (0-3), new dependencies (0-2), task type (0-3), risk flags (0-3). Map to tiers: 0-4 simple/haiku, 5-8 moderate/sonnet, 9-14 complex/opus. Parse task description for keywords to determine scores.
acceptance_criteria: Keyword parsing for task type and risk flags
